crossRefs.note: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?

translations.web: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
translations.bsb: “For they know not how to do right,” declares the LORD. “They store up violence and destruction in their citadels.”
translations.kjv: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
translations.asv: For they know not to do right, saith Jehovah, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
